about: The secreta of the formulary “First Sunday of Lent” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: We solemnly offer the sacrifice that openeth Lent, beseeching Thee, O Lord, that together with the restraint of bodily food we may also refrain from harmful pleasures. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God,
